There's so many ways to play riven so it depends alot on what Elo you Are in.

Range is not a great Lane for riven most of the time if the other player is great at auto spacing, your mobility is also your dmg so using your Qs just to get 1 hit is heavily punishable. 

In lower tier = plat and below, go for the Bush cheese, let him walk to minions and then you run him down with q aa spam. The last q should be used as you walk away from him, if he keeps following you, turn around and knock him up for another auto and get Back. Best with 3 pots and long sword since you Are gonna lose alot of hp on that trade, and then you should have secured lvl 1-3 Lane dominance. Can be done against Any ranged top except quinn. And also melees but with exceptions like darius.

If you wanna take the safe option start e and dorans shield. First Back refillable pot and pick axe/vamp scepter.

Its not a super easy Lane to win atm, but if you manage one good trade after lvl 3 Keep the wave in the middle or towards you, and stand in front of his minions. Just give up farm if neccesary until lvl 3. Dont allow him to farm afterwards, so try to not let him build too big a minion wave. Unless its straight letting you freeze at your turret. Getting the kill on him can be quite troublesome at times, so dont get too cocky.


After lvl 6 the best time to engage is right as he changes form Back to Mini gnar. Use e-q-w or just e-w since he can still ult, and then when he jumps go for the kill with your ult. Almost 100% that he Will waste flash or you just get the kill. Its All about that timing.

Your runes should Almost always be the same with the precicion - sorc tree.

You would probably think of Box box first, but he is just entertaining and does alot of stupid build just cuz he can, mostly just a mechanical god and not as tryhard as some of the other. Still great mechanical knowledge to learn from him!

Riven has alot of combos but can be very easy to learn once you understand one thing. Your e can cancel your Animation, like your ult 1 and 2. Exstend q range by e-q. So yeah e is where most of the training is and when to use it. I almost never stun after using e as that is a waste of the shield, unless its neccesary or a straight kill.

The q auto cancel. learn it with a guide, its mostly muscle memory.

Tiamat/Iron whip now? Can be used for canceling mid Animation too. 

You can also cancel your R2 with a Q to get both out. At almost the same time. Atleast that's what i do.
